cold_cohorts.aggregate_input_rate: actual input tokens divided by cohort elapsed; prefill service proxy, not kernel TPS
cold_cohorts.control: repeat demand zero; same factory, actual model, scope and prompts; zero imported tokens
cold_cohorts.measurement_scope: Mixed-cohort capture creation cost; packing overhead is not isolated unless the measured control actually packs the same donor range.
cold_cohorts.output_shape: forced length3/1/128, no early stop tokens; not a natural-answer quality benchmark
cold_cohorts.profile: production factory benchmark width3; serialized partials1; plain512/base2048/solo4096; SSD floor1024 unchanged
cold_cohorts.prompt_shape: pre-tokenized synthetic fixture, clipped to exact 1/2049/2800 token lengths
cold_cohorts.timing: Submit to first raw token/visible delta and finish; setup and post-request write completion are separate. strictFsync=false; write completion does not establish fsync durability.

limits: Three local pre-tokenized synthetic cohorts, exact1/2049/2800-token input and forced3/1/128-token output; no production or natural answer quality claim.
Runtime MTP disabled explicitly; the artifact declares and loads its actual assistant head. Earlier solo MTP-on timing aggregates remain separate.
Input tokens divided by cohort elapsed is a service proxy, not GPU kernel throughput. Aggregate output TPS includes prefill and measures tokens132/cohort elapsed.
No peak RSS, burst endurance or other dense-artifact performance qualification.
Counterbalanced candidate-first controls may see previously persisted scoped files in the file census; every control imported0 tokens and wrote0 files. Census positions are not new writes.
cold_summary.measurement: Mixed-cohort total capture-creation feature cost; all cells cold/no imported tokens. Same factory/profile/hint-zero versus demanded hint. Does not isolate packed-kernel overhead.
cold_summary.median_method: Median of each paired percentage; percentage ratios are calculated before aggregation.

curation: Numeric values unchanged. Legacy durable_drain_seconds keys renamed write_drain_seconds to describe waitForWritesForTesting accurately. All native fixtures use strictFsync=false; physical disk versus OS file cache is not separated.

limits: One cold-then-warm functional pair; not a repeat timing aggregate or fleet result.
Same MTP-off configuration as mixed cohort, separately seeded; no blocker hooks on fork/import.
Raw model token IDs matched; no bit-exact floating-point logits claim.
StageIO/decryption/native import are included in warm TTFT; model/factory setup excluded from both request times.
separate_warm_pair.measurement: Separate single cold/warm MTP-off fork; stage is included in TTFT. Same factory width3, one active fork, 2300 input/128 forced output. No blocker hooks or restore overrides. Not pooled with earlier timing aggregates.
